source: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012) — Shaxannada CUN, p. 921; reviewed DHEH paradigm p. 937 for affirmative irregular imperatives
rule: Recognize only exact reviewed imperative surfaces. Current CUN forms distinguish affirmative 2sg cun, affirmative 2pl cuna, negative 2sg cunin, and negative 2pl cunina. The surface cunin is syncretic with negative forms in other moods, so imperative interpretation requires clause context; do not classify every occurrence of cunin as imperative. Existing exact imperative records such as dheh/dhaha may also be recognized. Do not derive unseen imperative forms from endings.
